concept: Navigation that stays beside the content on a wide screen: sections on a pane, the current item chosen glass.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a dark grey vertical nav with a coloured left border on the active item (admin template sidebar)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured border is a hue and a single cue

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a tall level-1 pane beside the content, in every theme and on every scene

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the current item is chosen glass, semibold, in every theme and on every scene

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: section titles in the micro caps, the same as the book’s navigation

options: B grey rail with a coloured border
variants.reason: A is the book’s own sidebar in the system. B brings a hue. C does not show where the reader is.

pane.why: a tall glass pane, 280px wide, the same in every theme and on every scene

header.why: something at the top such as the product name

footer.why: something at the foot such as the signed-in person

section.why: a group of destinations, the same in every theme and on every scene

title.why: the section title in the micro caps, the same in every theme and on every scene

list.why: the destinations, one under another, the same in every theme and on every scene

item.why: a 44px destination row, the same in every theme and on every scene

icon.why: an icon at the icon size, the same in every theme and on every scene

label.why: the destination wraps onto a second line when long, so no name is cut, the same in every theme

badge.why: a count or a note in secondary text

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which item has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours mark the current item with the system highlight

hover.why: a row lightens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-current=page.why: the current row is chosen glass, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-current.why: the current item does not lighten on hover, because it is already the chosen pane

background-color.why: the tint eases at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
